medium.en: Albumen silver print from a glass negative
medium.zh: 蛋白银盐印相（玻璃底片）

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1884. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1884 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A sepia photograph of a calm sea under a heavy, luminous sky. A small two-masted ship sits on the horizon in the middle of the frame, sunlight breaks through the clouds at right, and the water in the foreground glitters.
alt.zh: 一张棕褐色调的照片：沉重而明亮的天空下，海面平静。一艘小小的双桅船停在画面中央的地平线上，阳光从右侧的云层中透出，前景的海水闪闪发亮。

note.en: Le Gray's seascapes caused a sensation in the 1850s. The plates of the time could rarely hold a bright sky and darker water in one exposure, and many of his seascapes were printed from two negatives; this one is catalogued as a single negative. Either way the patience is the same: waiting for the light and the ship to be right at once.
note.zh: 勒格雷的海景照片在 1850 年代轰动一时。当时的底片很难在一次曝光里同时留住明亮的天空和较暗的海水，他的许多海景是用两张底片合印的；这一张在馆藏记录里是单张底片。无论哪种，所需要的耐心是一样的：等光线和船同时到位。
